scope: Synthetic calibration of automatic structural proposals, joint coefficient fitting, and actual shared/untied bodies. Not pretrained-model discovery or VPD comparison.
candidate_grammar: one full-vector argument, at most three operations, ReLU / full affine / elementwise multiply; all generated expressions, no pruning based on singleton fits
target_selection: all up to three seeded eligible expressions with an internal affine between nonlinear operations; true formula and coefficients excluded from driver inputs
criterion: Report continuous decoded training and broader-support heldout maximum row errors, actual standalone C32, matched shared/untied controls, and oracle-topology fitted result. No success threshold adapted to results.
next_native_work_constraint: Clean-only Pareto is only a calibration screen. Native intervention prediction must enter fitting and selection before a real-model causal-discovery experiment. Do not discard a causally superior candidate because clean-only Pareto dominated it.
heldout: freeze Pareto plus matched controls before loading eval arrays; eval input radius2 versus training radius1; no retuning from eval
compute: Small synthetic CPU experiment. No GPU allocation before a consequential native experiment is executable.
